diagnosis: SimilarCaseStudyView returns related case studies using taggit's similar_objects() helper. Although the starting object is verified against request.user.organization, case.tags.similar_objects() performs an unscoped query over all TaggedItem records in the database. As a result, the returned list includes case studies and confidential client engagements belonging to other organizations.
